Why the padding goes on the right
The padding goes on the RIGHT, and that choice matters.
has to be the first real word, because
adds position information by column number. If
the padding went on the left, every real word would shift to a later position, and the same sentence would look different depending on how long the other sentences
in its batch were. Decoder-only models like GPT do the opposite and pad on the left, for the mirror-image reason: there the LAST position is the one that predicts
the next word, so it is the right edge that has to line up.
